Azadirachtin Q, in turn, is predicted to interact with Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1. This implies a chain of interactions where Neogitogenin may influence the activity of Sucrose porin, which then affects the function of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1. The evidence supports a mechanistic pathway where Neogitogenin could modulate the transport activity of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1 through its interaction with Sucrose porin and Azadirachtin Q. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as the scores indicate a partial confidence in the predicted interactions, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the biological relevance of these findings.
